Port Arend, October 1959
A few empty boxcars shuffle off toward tomorrow's work and a warm evening is coming down, as the Coasties tie up their 36' after assisting/standing by an excursion boat with carburetor problems. All back in, all O.K.
#ModelRailroad #Oscale #CoastGuard #GreatLakes #harbor

Port Arend, 1959
Like most other Lake Michigan towns, we have a spot inside the river lined with fish shanties, smoke houses, and big reels used for drying and mending cotton gill nets, though many are switching to nylon nets now.
#ModelRailroading #Oscale #history #GreatLakes #fishing #LakeMichigan

Old Snapshot Found
The Hutchinson Bros.' gill-net boat Laura Marie comes in off Lake Michigan to her dock on the Yesterday River at Port Arend. Probably about 1959 and probably early December as there's light snow on the ground.
#ModelRailroad #Oscale #GreatLakes #Fishing #photography #snapshot

Port Arend, 1959
Hutchinson Bros. opened up one end of this building and poured a new slab for what Susan had hoped would be a retail fish market she'd run. Now it looks like it'll be the shipyard tool shed and toilet.
#ModelRailroad #Oscale #SmallDream #diorama #GreatLakes

Port Arend, 1959
Old man Hutchinson catches a snooze in the warm sun. Says he can't sleep if no train goes by. Generations of his family have been born in this tiny tavern, a few rooms upstairs their home, here above Little Dog Creek.
#ModelRailroad #Oscale #diorama #GreatLakes #55ChevyNomad

Port Arend, 1959
A fine October day. That's Susan Hutchinson on the dock, shaking a kink out of the heavy bow line she's about to hand up to the family "fish tug", the Laura Marie, named for her late and legendary mother-in-law.
#ModelRailroad #Oscale #GreatLakes
#FishTug #LakeMichigan #fishing

Harbor Scene - First Light
Port Arend, October, 1959 ~
Morning in a Lake Michigan fishing town finds the gill-net boat "Laura Marie" just backing out of her slip and a Coast Guard 36' about to do the same.
#GreatLakes #ModelRailroad #Oscale #miniature #fishing #USCoastGuard

#OnThisDay June 23, 1888: A crowd gathers at Duluth harbor to watch the launching of "Barge 101," the world's first vessel of "whaleback" design. 39 more such vessels with uniquely curved decks would be built for Great Lakes service, some quite large and including one passenger ship.

Port Townsend, 1959
Down in Fish Town, the Irish Setter, Arlo, senses it may have been a good lift as Susan Hutchinson again prepares to hand up the bow line to the returning "Laura Marie". Harold tries to look busy with something over near the smokehouse.
#ModelRailroad #Oscale #Ogauge #GreatLakes

'Round the Freakin' Bend
(In Port Arend, 1959)
You can REALLY go nuts when you begin detailing the details. I mean, there isn't even any gullshit in this scene yet!
#diorama #ModelRailroad #Oscale #ScratchBuilt #miniature #Ogauge #GreatLakes #FishingBoat #harbor

Quiet Day ~
One of my favorites, the little Jacquelyn Yvonne, built right here in Sturgeon Bay for the army in 1943 as ST-173, she'd later be named Manistee, then Robert W. Purcell, before becoming the Jackie. She's had a number of paint schemes; I like this one.
#tugs #SturgeonBay #GreatLakes

Port Arend, 1959 ~
This third 18" x 72" diorama of the possibly imaginary little Great Lakes city of Port Arend is beginning to have some substance, helped along by today's wonderfully rainy weather.
#ModelRailroad #RailwayModel #Oscale #Ogauge #diorama

Snapshot 1959: Port Arend, a Great Lakes harbor town.
#modelrailroad #Ogauge #industry

Port Arend 1959
Still snow on the ground, but it looks like they'll start framing the retail addition to Hutchinson Bros. fish shanty. Fresh lake trout, whitefish, yellow perch. Smelt in season. Smoked chubs. Pickled herring. Yum.
#ModelRailroad #Oscale #GreatLakes #Fishing #construction
